name: qkd_ectl3_kiss_st-f2-COMMIT
purpose: S-KVASTK 2026-10-18: the static ECTL frame qkd_ectl3_kiss_st (die master qkd_ectlk x32) hardened as a WIRES-ONLY cluster of its three CLOSED views: A qkd_static_ectla_kiss (qkd_static_ectla_k3-r3-828d82516, CRITICAL), B qkd_ectl_b_tp8_direct (pg16 view: STATIC_QK 1 / RRL 21 / HXK 13 = the frame's die parameters; the base kit view is at the module defaults STATIC_QK 0 / RRL 9 / HXK 0 and would be functionally wrong here), C qkd_ectl_c_st (qkd_ectl_c_st-v1-f88e1e2c0). Children bottom-aligned on the 43.2 lattice (A x 43.2, B x 259.2, C x 561.6; y 43.2) so A.rs_o / B.rs_i and B.x_i / C.x_b keep their grant y (straight 43-um seams); C.x_a -> A.x_i (52 b) crosses B on M6. No parent logic (assign-only concatenation of t0 / t1), so no std-cell band. Exact io_tcl: every frame pin is the straight projection of its child pin (C's t0_q / t1_q / si / so runs spread in bit order to <= 5.3/um). Clock: three ENTRIES ck[0..2] on the N face straight above each child's ck pin (die delivers phi - R_i per entry; no parent tree). RTL: `ifndef KVD_ECTLK_HARD keeps the parameter overrides for simulation; the hard path instantiates the views without overrides (textbook_lint hard_child_params).

bench.cmd: mkdir -p {RUN} && printf '%s\n' 'module ot_lint_top; qkd_ectl3_kiss_st u_top (); endmodule' > {RUN}/ot_lint_top.sv && verilator --lint-only -Wno-fatal -Wno-lint -Wno-style -Wno-TIMESCALEMOD -Wno-MULTIDRIVEN -Wno-MODMISSING -DSYNTHESIS -DKVD_ECTLK_HARD --top-module ot_lint_top {RUN}/ot_lint_top.sv rtl/qwen_sys/static_kv_20261014/qkd_static_ectl_st.sv && echo lint-ok
